decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper builds directly on the firm's established construction machinery, so its own R&D can interpret feedback and refine it, and it kept its own page in 2024.
The articulated dumper extends the firm's core vehicle know-how and still has a page of its own, so the firm can assimilate market learning and improve it.

The rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and was reduced from its own page to a mention in 2024, which signals weakening priority, but its underground vehicle base and in-house R&D give enough related knowledge to keep it for now.
The multi-model telescopic loader line builds on established lifting and construction expertise and still has its own page, so it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well.
The material lift is close to the firm's long-standing lift business, and the website reports it as the most popular rental lift with a recent large order, which shows strong commercial traction.

Although distant from the established offer, the mining loader has a page of its own and quantified field evidence of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months, which gives the R&D-active firm results it can learn from.
